problem_type: Missing default availability in the Agent context redirects model choice back to the creator
symptom: With Auto select, drafting without modelId refuses and the panel sends the creator to the model menu.
direct_cause: The shared model index omitted missing defaults, while the refusal Next and panel delegated model selection to the user.
class_root: The Agent-facing default projection did not distinguish known absence from an unread preference and did not assign explicit model choice to the Agent.
affected_population: Image and video drafting with no usable saved default
Live context versus catalog deltas and historical compaction
entry_points: laneHost live model index with resolver defaults
Catalog delta and compaction index without defaults
internal_only_reason: The user explicitly chose Agent selection while preserving host refusal and spend approval; this is an internal ownership rule, not third-party runtime behavior. The Auto-select edge was identified during implementation review; the user then chose the product behavior recorded in docs/plan/2026-11-09-agent-auto-model-drafting.md. The original host refusal was an intentional safety boundary, which remains unchanged.
invariants: Only the live resolver answer may assert absence of a usable saved default.
Without a default, the Agent must explicitly name an available model and report its display name.
The host still refuses omitted identity and never chooses by catalog order.
The failure panel reports the reason without sending creators to the model menu.

door_reduction.why_not: laneHost projects live authority; laneContextBudget projects historical context; laneModelContext projects catalog deltas. All three must remain, using the same formatter; the latter two omit defaults and must not invent absence. The resolver reader keeps settings interpretation centralized; problem text and Next share the problem projection; both panel summary/detail share problemSentence and useAgentPanelV4Data consumes detail. Each is an existing layer boundary, not a second model selector.

generality_proof: A single formatter covers all four task kinds and keeps unknown defaults distinct from known missing ones; all refusal throw sites share the same problem-text and Next projection. Host admission and approval remain unchanged.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Project live defaults or missing-default guidance from the same resolver result without asserting absence for unread contexts.
Give every no_default_model refusal an executable explicit-model retry.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Live transform_context supplies options.modelDefaults() from readLaneDeclaredDefaults.
Historical compaction supplies no defaults; tests require no false absence.
Both no_default_model throw sites use refuseGeneration and the shared model text and Next.

recurrence.reason: Any task kind without a usable default and every future run can encounter the same omission.
same_class_scan: door-map refuseGeneration: four files/eight calls; repository search no_default_model finds three direct throw sites
list_models and declaredDefaultDeviations contain catalog facts and deviation facts respectively, not a second default interpreter

prevention.invariant: Known missing defaults always carry explicit Agent model-selection guidance; unread defaults never claim absence.
prevention.failure_mode: No explicit model and no usable default still refuses with no_default_model and charged=false.
prevention.strategy: Replace silent missing-default omission with task-indexed guidance in the existing shared projection; delete the old panel instruction.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the panel menu instruction and both locale keys; retain existing refusal admission and historical next decoding.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency or runtime change; only existing domain projections.

migration: No saved data or schema changes; saved defaults still resolve through the same owner. Existing historical next values remain readable.
residual_risks: Real model compliance is unverified: this round explicitly forbids live models.
A scripted fixture proves tool and panel behavior, not autonomous model selection.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The live resolver result is projected once for all task kinds; unread contexts cannot assert absence, and admission plus retry text stay at the existing shared generation boundary.
